summary: Completed testing of Pixel360 client logo upload feature. All 11 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend admin panel logo upload UI working correctly. Homepage displays uploaded logos with grayscale filter.
critical_code_review_comments: Logo upload flow works correctly: Upload file -> API returns logo_url -> State updated -> User saves section
Image resize working: Large images resized to max 200x80 while maintaining aspect ratio
File validation working: Only jpg, png, gif, webp, svg allowed
Grayscale filter applied to logos on homepage with hover effect to show color
seed_data_creation: TechCorp client has logo_url set to /uploads/logos/visible_test_logo.png
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo upload feature fully tested. Backend endpoints: POST /api/upload/logo (upload), GET /api/upload/logos (list), DELETE /api/upload/logo/{filename} (delete). Admin UI at /admin/site-content -> Partner & Müşteri Logoları section. Homepage displays logos in 'BÜYÜME ORTAKLARIMIZ' marquee with grayscale filter.

backend_upload_endpoint.details: POST /api/upload/logo accepts image files, validates type, resizes to max 200x80, returns logo_url

backend_list_logos.details: GET /api/upload/logos returns list of all uploaded logos with filename and url

backend_delete_logo.details: DELETE /api/upload/logo/{filename} removes logo file from server

backend_file_validation.details: Invalid file types (text/plain) rejected with 400 error

backend_image_resize.details: Large images resized using Pillow to max 200x80 maintaining aspect ratio

admin_logo_upload_ui.details: Admin panel /admin/site-content shows 'Logo Görseli Yükle' button for each client, file input accepts images, upload shows success toast

admin_logo_preview.details: Uploaded logos show preview image and URL in admin panel

admin_remove_logo.details: 'Görseli Kaldır' button appears for clients with uploaded logos

homepage_logo_display.details: Uploaded logos displayed in 'BÜYÜME ORTAKLARIMIZ' marquee section using tag

homepage_grayscale_filter.details: Logos have grayscale(1) filter applied, CSS hover effect defined for color transition

integration_flow.details: Full flow working: Admin uploads logo -> File saved to /uploads/logos/ -> logo_url stored in trust_badges section -> Homepage fetches and displays

api_endpoints_tested: POST /api/upload/logo - Upload logo with file and brand_name
GET /api/site/sections/trust_badges - Get client logos with logo_url
